0.0.n: Gives the length of time measured backward by 前.

0.1.n: After a time span, 前 tells you how far back something happened.

0.2.n: Links the time expression to the case, identifying when it happened.

0.3.n: Combines with 婚 to describe marriage through meeting on a dating app.

0.4.n: Used as part of アプリ婚, not as a standalone word here.

0.5.n: Combines with 殺人 to describe a series of murders.

0.6.n: Combines with 連続 and 事件 to form the phrase for a serial murder case.

0.7.n: Names the earlier criminal case that the new incident resembles.

0.8.n: Marks the earlier case as the thing the new incident resembles.

0.10.n: With 似る, よく emphasizes strong resemblance rather than frequency.

0.11.n: The た-form of 似る describes the following 事件; it expresses resemblance, not necessarily past time.

0.12.n: Refers to the new occurrence being compared with the earlier case.

0.13.n: Marks 事件 as what has occurred.

0.14.n: 起きる + ています is polite and presents the occurrence as currently relevant.

1.0.n: This is the person's family name, placed before the given name.

1.1.n: This character is part of the given name 吐夢, not a separate word here.

1.2.n: This character completes the given name 吐夢; it does not independently mean dream here.

1.3.n: Added after the full name to show respect without specifying gender.

1.4.n: Marks the person the speaker cannot reach.

1.5.n: Used in 連絡が取れる, an expression for being able to reach someone.

1.6.n: Marks 連絡 within the expression 連絡が取れる.

1.7.n: Polite negative of 取れる, the can-do form of 取る; with 連絡, it means being unable to reach someone.

0.lit: An incident closely resembling the dating-app marriage serial murder case of two years ago has occurred.
0.tip: The pattern Aとよく似たB means B closely resembling A.

1.lit: With Nagayama Tomu, contact cannot be established.
1.tip: 連絡が取れません is a polite way to say you cannot get in touch with someone.
